summary: This function works out the energy charge for a customer's units used, based on tariff code A1 (tiered by units) or A2 (flat rate per unit), and returns zero for any other tariff.

rules.text: For tariff A1, if units used are above 300, every unit is charged at 22 per unit, with no tiers applied to the earlier units.
For tariff A1, units up to 100 are charged at 10 per unit.
For tariff A1, units from 101 to 200 are charged 10 per unit for the first 100 units and 13 per unit for each unit above 100.
For tariff A1, units from 201 to 300 are charged 10 per unit for the first 100, 13 per unit for the next 100, and 16 per unit for each unit above 200.
For tariff A2, every unit is charged at a flat 25 per unit, with no tiers.
Any tariff other than A1 or A2 gets an energy charge of zero.
The final energy charge is rounded to 2 decimal places before it is returned.
When the debug switch is turned on, the function prints the tariff, units and resulting charge to the output log; this does not change the amount returned.
